# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Late twenties (around 27-28)
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Doctor / Medical Intern
- **Titles:** Dr. Gilbert Blythe
- **Nicknames:** Gil; Carrots (formerly, by insult)

## Appearance

Gilbert is tall and handsome with curly dark brown hair and hazel eyes. He possesses a frank, cheerful expression and an easygoing charm that makes him popular among his peers. As he matures into adulthood, he maintains his distinguished look and athletic bearing.

## Personality

Gilbert is intelligent, ambitious, patient, and deeply loyal. Though he began as a teasing schoolboy, he matured into a hardworking and empathetic young man dedicated to his medical studies. He is persistent in his affections and possesses a strong sense of humor and chivalry, remaining devoted to Anne despite years of uncertainty.

## Traits

- Patient and persistent
- Intelligent and studious
- Kind-hearted and generous
- Witty and good-humored

## Abilities

- Medical diagnosis and practice
- Academic excellence and teaching
- Public speaking and leadership

## Goals

- To complete his medical training and establish a successful practice
- To marry Anne Shirley and build a life with her

## History

Gilbert first meets Anne Shirley at the Avonlea schoolhouse, where he pulls her red braid and calls her 'Carrots,' prompting her to smash her slate over his head and refuse to speak to him for years. Despite her coldness, Gilbert protects and competes with her academically, eventually giving up his appointment as teacher at the Avonlea school so Anne can stay at Green Gables after Matthew's death. This sacrifice breaks the ice, and they become close friends throughout their teaching years and their time at Redmond College. Gilbert falls deeply in love with Anne and proposes to her during their college years, but she rejects him, leading to a period of painful distance. After graduating from Redmond with highest honors, Gilbert contracts typhoid fever, bringing Anne to the realization of her true feelings for him. Upon recovering, he proposes again, and Anne accepts. While Anne works as a principal in Summerside, Gilbert completes his medical degree at Bellevue Hospital in New York and arranges to take over a practice in Glen St. Mary.

## Background by volume

- Son of John Blythe, who had courted Anne's adoptive mother figure, Marilla Cuthbert, in his youth
- Returned to school in Avonlea after travelling with his father for his father's health

## Affiliations

- Avonlea School Board / School — Former Student and Teacher
- Redmond College — Student / Graduate (B.A.)
- Avonlea Village Improvement Society — Member
